Page 32 Cont.
Mar. Peter Curcarn - 55 - neglecting family - keeping bad company. Philip Paul Curcarn
Geo Whitmore - 45 - of 14453 Lappin reports of his son nearly killed in Detroit, May 1931 .... boy now married and in service .wants record of his cure ....
Mrs. D. Stratman - 40 - 6 tumors removed.
Page 33 Mar. Terence Daniel Vaughan - 13 -"Polinuritis" very peculiar - almost singular case for about a year. Dr's know of no remedy; weighed 92 lbs a year ago; now 50 - though has grown tall - long rather since he can only lie immovable. Still hopes as from early child- hood to be a missionary.
Margaret Fulture - 44 - "Dying of Cancer"
Rev. Alvin Bina O. F.M. - Chaplin reported "Missing"
28 Gerald Sierakowski - 3 - tumor on brain partly removed Feb. 17 convulsions. Just now 10:15 a.m. had sad one here in Office - tenth since last night at 9 o'cl.
April
1945, April Mary Joan Buslepp - 5 months - lukemia in Providence H'p'l.
Clare O'Connor - 36 - new President of "News Paper Union" En- rolls in Ser. Mass Ass'n etc, for harmony etc, etc .... . prayers for guidance.
Page 34 April 4 D. McGilvray - 56 - in St. Elizabeth Hospital - Brighton, Mass .- had leg amputated ..... Gangrene set in ..... very little hope.
Carlyn Iynas - 63 - serious throat trouble.
6 Mrs. Anna Cornelissen - 62 - Very serious condition from cancer - lost one breast three yrs. ago - now whole system seems infected ...
7 Mrs. Leona Mckerrell - 45 - "dying of stomach cancer ... Enrolled specially To-day 2.00
